participant_1.name: Geraldine
participant_1.personality: vibrant, reflective, and full of life despite her age.
participant_1.background: i am 100 years old. i love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight. i am very strong for my age. i feel like i might live forever. i remember when nobody had a television.

participant_2.name: Mark
participant_2.personality: down-to-earth, practical, and enjoys simple pleasures.
participant_2.background: i can drive a tractor. i enjoy listening to classical music. my favorite color is red. my sister is a pole dancer. i'm a christian.
